questions.question: Who did Pilate send Jesus to for questioning?
What did the criminal on the cross ask Jesus?
options: To save them both from the cruel death they faced
To prove himself the Christ by coming down
To remember him when he came into his Kingdom
To forgive the soldiers for what they did
questions.answer: To remember him when he came into his Kingdom
